import {
  buildCreateDialogueResumeInput,
  resolveFlowFirstCreateWorkflowMatch,
} from './src/stately-studio/actors/shared/workflow-registry.ts';

const completeRecord = {
  flowId: 'flow-1',
  module: 'create',
  workflowType: 'entity_create',
  status: 'awaiting_review',
  createPlan: {},
  createDrafts: {},

  activeFlows: {
    a: completeRecord,

  focusedFlowId: null,
  recentFlowIds: [],
